She's a celebrity at Hoshimoto Gakuen High School. She's just as beautiful as her sister, a popular idol, but unlike her sister, Kohaku is a beauty who kept people at a.distance with her cold attitude.

Although they were both aware of each other’s daily presence, they never tried to interact with each other. One day, however, when the restaurant was especially crowded, Kouta was offered a seat at Kohaku's table. And then he got a phone call from home. When he finished that call, Kohaku started talking to him…

This eccentric duo has but one goal—to find a stable planet where they can settle down on!

However, every world the two visit is a little off… A planet with a god that can revive the dead, a planet where lucky people reign supreme, a planet lined with endless libraries… Can the girls navigate the unique challenges posed by each bizarre world and live to reach the next leg of their journey? 174618.description:
Set in the years 2004–2005 of the Japanese Generation 1 continuity, it tells the tale of a conflict between the Cybertrons and Destrons in which a set of dimensional fissures known as the Blastizone brings forth characters from across time and space to the present day on Earth, serving as a big crossover event between Generation 1, Beast Wars, Victory, Beast Wars II, and more, in honor of the Transformers brand's 20th anniversary.

The series was published online through Takara's official website from 2004 to 2005, for a total of thirteen chapters. Each consisted of two pages and accompanying prose that expanded the comics' story. Being the longest-running of the Robotmasters fiction, the online chapters told the majority of the series's story and was the only one to see it through to a proper conclusion. Additionally, two physical comics, each four pages at length, were also published in catalogs packaged with the Robotmasters toys, and served as complementary in-between chapters to the online comic.

Masaharu is a teacher at a low-ranking school who only got hired because of his grandfather's connections. For years, he's been overworked by his superiors, unable to fit in with his colleagues, and living a repressed life. His latest source of trouble is his disobedient student, Kanami. One night, while patrolling the streets at night on the principal's orders, he comes across Kanami being harassed by some delinquents and rescues her with a spur-of-the-moment lie. He realizes she has run away from home when he notices the large luggage she is carrying. With no friends and nowhere to go, Kanami pleads with him for help, and he ends up bringing her home.

She manages to talk him into letting her stay at his place, and she sexually provokes him almost every day until he could no longer control himself and he finally pounces on Kanami. However, when he sees her awkward reaction, Masaharu realizes that Kanami's teasing was just her putting on a brave front. Kanami might act lewd, but she is actually a pure, devoted, and kind, girl, and before he knows it, he is falling for her…

(Source: Otona Bunko, translated)

174675.description:
"I can come stay with you."

I was supposed to share an apartment with my friend. But when the arrangement fell through, I was at a loss.

"We're friends, so aren't we supposed to help each other?"
"It'll be only for a limited time."

Kitazawa is a handsome guy, and even though he's a bit of a jerk, we hit it off right away from the moment we met. It was special and comforting to have a "best friend" like him even after I graduated. So we move in together, but we each have our own rooms, so it's not like we're really living together. As long as we're just friends and we keep our distance, it'll be fine…

…but it's not fine.

I have always loved Kitazawa. I thought I had it under control until now. I should have been able to control these feelings, and not say those things I shouldn't have said. But if we do this, we can't live together like this anymore.

"…why don't you just be with me?"

The moment I told him that we can't "live together" anymore, Kitazawa suddenly kissed me…

(Source: DLSite, translated)

174677.description:
Shirley, the daughter of a frontier count, is mistreated by her family every day. When her step-sister tries to kill her, she ends up running away to the neighboring country. She isn't suppose to go into the enemy territory, which is rumored to be "vicious and cruel." But… she had nowhere else to go. At a loss in the foreign land, she receives a proposal to marry Duke Oliver, who is a knight of the enemy kingdom!

(Source: BookLive, translated)

title.romaji: Meshitsukai Reijou wa Kokkyou wo Koe, Tekkoku no Koushaku Kishi-sama ni Dekiaisareru

174678.description:
The world is filled with supernatural objects that house distortions of the world called “Vanits.” Shin Karamori wields one such artifact—an azure sword that granted his wish to live and gave him incredible combat abilities yet curses all those around him. Karamori throws himself body and soul into fighting bloody battles involving Vanits, accompanied by an artificial young girl named Archive, whose fate is dictated by a certain book. Karamori fights to save an important figure from his past, and he'll do anything to make it happen, even if that means Archive losing her life. When the tragic pair meets a high school girl, the wheels of fate rapidly start to spin. But is the future awaiting them one of annihilation...or something else?

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Winner of the Gold Prize in the 30th Dengeki Novel Taisho.

title.english: The Azure Sword, Slayer of Distortions

174679.description:
Oharu, the heir to a poor yakuza family whose territory is shrinking due to aging, is worried about the future of his group. His foster father, the young boss Jin, has resorted to extreme measures in order to pay off his superiors.... Even if they considered to earn money, the jobs he could do were limited because yakuza can't open bank accounts. Then he happened to come across a poet who makes handmade accessories, and came up with the idea of creating and selling his own accessories... Anti-social forces, gambling and drug addiction... what is the destination of those who can't make ends meet on the streets?

(Source: Manga Jam, translated)

174683.description:
Tomoki had never dated anyone in his life, but he had fallen in love - with Michiru, an online friend from a social networking app. Handsome, kind, refined, thoughtful Michiru (who he'd still never met in person)...! When Tomoki happened to see Michiru out on the street one day, he summoned up a lifetime's worth of courage and managed to speak to him. They even wound up making plans to go out on a date...! Except now something feels off. Michiru is just as suave and stylish as Tomoki imagined, but he's weirdly a lot meaner?!
So begins the love story between a cruel "prince" and his gutsy "princess"!

174685.description:
When the nobility tries to monopolize magic, the crime rate surges. As a countermeasure, the Empire establishes a bureau dedicated to investigating magical crimes. Rogue, a detective, is reassigned to the sixth branch office because of his superior's-Velladonna's-scheming. There, he'll work alongside a witch who almost destroyed the Empire Because of the dangers such witches pose, they are bound with collars that restrict their power. However, Rogue's charming new partner, "the Puppeteer," has no qualms about toying with him!

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Grand Prize winner in the 30th Dengeki Novel Awards.

174686.description:
"If it's the two of us, I'm sure there's nothing to be afraid of."

Mizuki Ayase, who lives in a seaside town with a mermaid legend, was the only one at school who smiled and lied. However, something happens and she starts spending time with Sou Hasumi, the lone wolf in her class. The two of them have a "secret" in common...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
